2609.02215.title: ASCII Attack: Recontextualising Harmful Requests as Artistic Critique in Large Language Models
2609.02215.paper_summary: Safety alignment trains large language models to refuse harmful requests stated plainly, but that training is applied mostly to surface form. Requests that only recontextualise the same operational content, changing how the model reads it, are therefore only weakly covered. The ASCII Attack is one such recontextualisation. It is single-turn and black-box: one message, with no access to model internals. It embeds a fully legible harmful request in ASCIl-art characters, presents it as artwork, and asks for feedback. Unlike ArtPrompt, it hides nothing: the request stays readable. The reply is written as artistic critique and can contain operational detail that a plain request would have been refused for. Every framed prompt is paired with a direct-question control, so the contrast is isolated from topic, model and decoding variation. The contrast identifies a bundled surface, not one isolated channel. Across eleven models and eight harm topics, a harm-aware classifier judges 62% of framed prompts harmful against 42% of controls. On the most susceptible model the framed prompt succeeds 93% of the time. A single query matches or exceeds published single-query attacks under four of five harm judges. The effect tracks the model more than the topic and does not diminish with scale. At least one judge dissents from the panel majority on nearly two-thirds of framed rows, which is itself a measurement-validity finding. That pattern is consistent with mismatched generalisation.
2609.02215.paper_summary_zh: 安全對齊訓練大型語言模型拒絕明確表述的有害請求，但該訓練主要應用於表面形式。僅重新語境化相同操作內容的請求，因此僅受到微弱覆蓋。ASCII攻擊就是這樣的一種重新語境化。它是單輪次且為黑箱：一條消息，無法訪問模型內部。它將一個完全可讀的有害請求嵌入ASCIl-art字符中，將其呈現為藝術作品，並要求反饋。與ArtPrompt不同，它沒有隱藏任何內容：請求保持可讀。回覆以藝術評論的形式寫成，並且可以包含普通請求會被拒絕的操作細節。每個框架提示都與直接問題控制配對，因此對比是從主題、模型和解碼變化中孤立出來的。這種對比識別了一個捆綁的表面，而不是一個孤立的通道。在十一個模型和八個有害主題中，一個意識到危害的分類器判斷62%的框架提示為有害，對比42%的控制。在最易受影響的模型中，框架提示成功率達93%。單一查詢在五個有害評判中的四個下匹配或超過已發表的單一查詢攻擊。這一效果更與模型相關，而非主題，並且隨著規模的擴大並不減弱。至少有一位評判在近三分之二的框架行中與小組多數意見相左，這本身就是一項測量有效性的發現。這一模式與不匹配的泛化一致。
